title: Operational alerts and focused chat
summary: Add privacy-safe roster and access alerts, targeted mentions and replies, a 14-day chat retention policy, admin attention indicators and browser smoke coverage.
changes: Optional roster-update notifications can now alert registered devices after staffing, allocation or night-only role changes, using privacy-safe wording and a deep link to the affected night.

Administrators get a compact attention badge for pending access requests, selected-night actions or a roster publication window nearing its end, and can receive a privacy-safe push when a new access request is created.
Anaesthetic Team supports @mentions from the current registered roster, with targeted mention notifications that can still reach the mentioned nurse when ordinary Team alerts are muted.
Team and private messages can reply to a specific message with a compact quoted preview, while the existing copy and recent-own-message deletion actions remain available.
Chat messages are automatically removed after 14 days by a server-side scheduled retention job.
A lightweight real-browser smoke suite now checks the shipped mobile shell, navigation and dark-mode presentation in addition to the existing deterministic regression tests.
